description: We are EARTH ON FIRE 🔥, a team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge, working on harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS satellite fire data. Our goal is to turn complex satellite observations into meaningful insights through an interactive wildfire monitoring platform. We welcome creative, motivated people interested in technology, data, science, and problem-solving. Beginners are welcome — curiosity and teamwork matter most!
summary:
EARTH ON FIRE is a web-based platform designed to make NASA's MODIS and VIIRS fire hotspot data easier to explore, compare, and understand across Africa.

Our solution combines data from both satellite instruments through an automated pipeline that collects, cleans, standardizes, and updates fire observations every 24 hours. The platform presents this information through an interactive dashboard featuring geographic heatmaps, daily activity trends, satellite comparisons, and analytical visualizations.

Users can explore detections by African region and country, filter by date, satellite instrument, confidence level, and day or night observations, and track changes over time through an interactive timeline.

We also designed Individual and Company experiences to support personal area monitoring and business-related site monitoring.

By bringing MODIS and VIIRS observations into one accessible platform while preserving their original sensor information, EARTH ON FIRE helps users better understand the geographic and temporal patterns of satellite-detected fire activity and makes complex Earth observation data more accessible and actionable.
